scientific_integrity: The two-parameter finite-time Lebesgue escape formula follows analytically from a fully specified five-interval Markov partition; finite-rational tests are supplementary. Historical priority and independent validation are not certified.
scientific_limitations: The proof concerns the specified strict open parameter chamber only.
No claim of maximality among all negative-doubling holes.
Finite-time survivor measure, not positive topological entropy.
Pointwise asymptotic, not uniform at the chamber boundary.
title: Quadratic dyadic escape throughout an asymmetric negative-doubling hole chamber
